stall for time: When the teacher asked about his homework, Tom tried to stall for time by asking a different question.
老師問起他的作業時，湯姆試圖用問別的問題來拖延時間。
talks stalled: The peace talks stalled for weeks, but both sides finally agreed to meet again in December.
和平談判停滯了好幾週，但雙方最後同意在十二月再次會面。
the engine stalled: We were halfway up the steep hill when the engine stalled, so we had to call for help.
我們爬到陡坡一半時引擎熄火了，所以我們只好打電話求救。
stall the process: Missing documents can stall the process of getting a visa for several weeks, so check everything first.
缺少文件可能會使申請簽證的流程拖延好幾週，所以要先檢查所有東西。
the economy stalled: During the pandemic the economy stalled, and many small shops had to close their doors forever.
疫情期間經濟停滯，許多小店不得不永久關門。
stamp out corruption: The new mayor promised to stamp out corruption by checking how every official spends public money.
新市長承諾要檢查每位官員如何花用公款，以根除貪腐。
stamp one's authority: The new coach wanted to stamp his authority on the team, so he made strict rules on the first day.
新教練想對球隊展現權威，所以第一天就訂下嚴格的規定。
stamp one's feet: The little boy began to stamp his feet and cry loudly when his mother refused to buy him candy.
當媽媽拒絕買糖果給他時，小男孩開始跺腳並大聲哭鬧。
rubber-stamp a decision: Some people complain that the committee only meets to rubber-stamp a decision the boss has already made.
有些人抱怨委員會開會只是為了橡皮圖章式通過老闆早已做好的決定。
stamp a document: The clerk will stamp a document with a red official seal once it has been approved.
文件一經核准，職員就會在上面蓋紅色的官方印章。
leave one's stamp on: The famous architect hoped to leave his stamp on the city by designing a unique tower.
那位知名建築師希望藉由設計一座獨特的高塔，在這座城市留下自己的印記。
can't stand the noise: I can't stand the noise from the construction site next door, so I study in the library instead.
我受不了隔壁工地的噪音，所以改到圖書館讀書。
stand the test of time: Good songs stand the test of time; people still love to sing them fifty years later.
好歌經得起時間考驗；五十年後人們仍然喜歡唱。
stand a chance: If you don't practice speaking every day, you won't stand a chance in the English speech contest.
如果你不每天練習說話，你在英語演講比賽中就沒有機會。
stand trial: The man who stole the paintings from the museum will stand trial next month in Taipei.
從博物館偷走畫作的那名男子下個月將在台北受審。
stand for election: My aunt has decided to stand for election as mayor because she wants to improve local schools.
我阿姨決定參選市長，因為她想改善地方學校。
stand by one's decision: Even though her friends laughed at her plan, she chose to stand by her decision to study art.
雖然朋友們嘲笑她的計畫，她仍選擇堅持學藝術的決定。
stand out: Wearing a bright red coat in a crowd of dark suits made her stand out immediately.
在一群深色西裝中穿著鮮紅色外套，讓她立刻顯得很突出。
stand up for: It takes courage to stand up for classmates who are being bullied, but it is the right thing to do.
挺身捍衛被霸凌的同學需要勇氣，但這是正確的事。
stand in for: Our English teacher is sick today, so Mr. Lin will stand in for her during the first two classes.
我們的英文老師今天生病，所以林老師會在前兩節課代替她。
star in a film: The young actress was thrilled when she was invited to star in a film directed by her hero.
那位年輕女演員受邀主演她偶像所執導的電影時，非常興奮。
a star-studded cast: The new superhero movie has a star-studded cast, so tickets sold out within hours.
這部新的超級英雄電影眾星雲集，所以電影票幾個小時內就賣光了。
starring role: After years of small parts, he finally got a starring role in a popular TV drama.
演了多年小角色後，他終於在一部熱門電視劇中得到主角的角色。
be starred: Important emails can be starred so that you can find them quickly when you need them later.
重要的電子郵件可以被標星，這樣之後需要時就能很快找到。
stare death in the face: Lost in the snowy mountains for three days, the climbers had to stare death in the face.
在雪山中迷路三天，登山者們不得不直面死亡。
stare into space: Instead of listening to the teacher, Amy sat by the window and began to stare into space, lost in daydreams.
艾咪沒有聽老師講課，而是坐在窗邊開始發呆，沉浸在白日夢裡。
the answer stares you in the face: Sometimes the answer stares you in the face, but you are too nervous to notice it.
有時候答案就在眼前，但你太緊張而沒注意到。
stare at the screen: If you stare at the screen for hours without a break, your eyes will feel tired and dry.
如果你連續好幾個小時盯著螢幕不休息，眼睛會感到疲勞又乾澀。
